principle: Timing class is target-relative; economic orientation separately defines whether an increase/decrease is beneficial or adverse.

indicators.name: TPCA PCB Revenue YoY
indicators.role: Early external demand/throughput signal before ABF company revenue confirmation.
indicators.positive_case: PCB industry revenue momentum rises → supports future ABF revenue.
indicators.negative_case: PCB industry revenue momentum falls → warns of future ABF revenue weakness.

indicators.name: ABF Company Monthly Revenue YoY
indicators.role: Confirms that industry demand is already reaching company revenue.
indicators.positive_case: Revenue momentum improves → confirms current operating strength.
indicators.negative_case: Revenue momentum deteriorates → confirms current operating weakness.

indicators.name: ABF Revenue YoY Basket
indicators.source: Derived median of 欣興 / 景碩 / 南電
indicators.role: Reduces company-specific noise and represents the common ABF revenue cycle.
indicators.positive_case: Revenue momentum improves → confirms current operating strength.
indicators.negative_case: Revenue momentum deteriorates → confirms current operating weakness.

indicators.name: Gross Margin
indicators.role: Confirms that demand/revenue improvement has propagated through utilization, pricing, mix and fixed-cost absorption.
indicators.note: Lag and sensitivity are not yet empirically calibrated.
indicators.positive_case: Gross margin expands → confirms better pricing/utilization/mix or cost absorption.
indicators.negative_case: Gross margin contracts → confirms pricing/utilization/mix/cost pressure.

indicators.name: Operating Margin
indicators.role: Confirms operating leverage after gross-profit improvement and OPEX absorption.
indicators.note: Lag and sensitivity are not yet empirically calibrated.
indicators.positive_case: Operating margin expands → confirms operating leverage.
indicators.negative_case: Operating margin contracts → confirms negative operating leverage.

indicators.name: EPS
indicators.role: Late financial confirmation that operating changes have propagated through the income statement.
indicators.note: Lag and sensitivity are not yet empirically calibrated.
indicators.positive_case: EPS improves → confirms positive earnings propagation.
indicators.negative_case: EPS deteriorates → confirms negative earnings propagation.
